name: services/users/search_by_email
description:
Search for users with a given email address.

  • We do not guarantee the uniqueness of users' emails. Therefore, there might actually be more than one result for your query.
  • We store only one email address per user. Some users use aliases (alternate names for their email accounts), this method won't help you identify users of such aliases.
brief_description: Search for users with a given email address.

arguments.name: email
arguments.description: Email address. Must be an exact match (case insensitive).

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section of user method.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: List of dictionaries. Each dictionary contains a user description, as defined in the user method.
